title: Remove misleading ORDER BY in worldQuery overlay lookup
description: Tech-debt review finding. worldQuery orders overlay_facts rows by updated_at and folds last-wins, but overlay_facts key is a PRIMARY KEY so there is exactly one row per field. The ordering and the multi-row comment are dead and misleading. Drop the ORDER BY or correct the comment. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
close_reason: Removed misleading worldQuery overlay ORDER BY and corrected latest-wins comment; added guard test. Verification: npx vitest run packages/core/test/world.test.ts passed (24 tests); npm run typecheck remains blocked by unrelated CLI TS errors recorded in comments. PR: https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/39
